/* 同 boot 内事件序号必须逐条 +1。跳号到达（1、3、4）意味着丢掉的那一条
   可能就是「物品离位」，此时既不能声称历史完整，也不能直接进确认
   （审计 R3-B-12：探针实测 continuity=1、fetch_gap=0、history_complete=1）。 */
static void test_event_sequence_gap(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;
    locker_device_event_t event;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 1u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT);
    dv_arm_operation(fixture.core, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                     LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_ACTIVE, 0x50u);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->cursor.continuity_ok);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->active.history_complete);

    /* seq=1 是首条（水位还是 0）：正常应用，不判缺口。 */
    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_DOOR_OPENED, 1u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_OPEN;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->cursor.continuity_ok);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->fetch_gap);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(1u, fixture.core->cursor.through.event_seq);

    /* 跳到 3：中间那条 2 永远补不回来。 */
    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_ITEM_REMOVED, 3u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_OPEN;
    event.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->cursor.continuity_ok);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->fetch_gap);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->active.history_complete);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(3u, fixture.core->cursor.through.event_seq);

    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
}

/* 设备路径的状态推进也必须是「候选副本 + 一次提交」：提交失败时内存不能
   已经跳到核验，否则 domain_require_review 遇到「内存已是 REVIEW_REQUIRED」
   会短路返回 OK，核验结论永远补不进仓储
   （审计 R3-B-7：探针注入 commit_status=IO_ERROR 后 active=REVIEW_REQUIRED、
   stored=ACCESS_PENDING、publish_calls=1）。 */
static void test_reply_commit_failure(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;
    locker_device_reply_t reply;
    domain_operation_t loaded;
    locker_uuid_t id;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 1u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT);
    dv_arm_operation(fixture.core, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                     LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_PENDING, 0x50u);
    id = fixture.core->active.id;
    dt_uuid_fill(&fixture.core->active.command_id, 0x90u);
    fixture.core->active.has_command = true;
    TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_persist_operation(fixture.core, &fixture.core->active));
    fixture.core->pending_command_valid = true;
    fixture.core->pending_command_id = fixture.core->active.command_id;
    fixture.core->execute_in_flight = true;

    /* 折叠成 18 字节前缀的失败应答（body 全零），落 BAD_PRECONDITION。 */
    fixture.repo->commit_status = LOCKER_STATUS_IO_ERROR;
    memset(&reply, 0, sizeof(reply));
    reply.message_type = (uint8_t)(7u | 0x80u);
    reply.body.execute_unlock.result = LOCKER_WIRE_RESULT_BAD_PRECONDITION;
    domain_reply_apply(fixture.core, &reply);

    /* 内存与库都停在 ACCESS_PENDING：这次核验没能落库，下一帧还能再推一次。 */
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_PENDING, fixture.core->active.state);
    memset(&loaded, 0, sizeof(loaded));
    TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_operation_load(fixture.core, &id, 1, &loaded));
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_PENDING, loaded.state);

    /* 提交恢复后同样的应答能把结论写进去（证明只是「这次失败」，不是永久拒绝）。 */
    fixture.repo->commit_status = LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
    fixture.core->pending_command_valid = true;
    fixture.core->pending_command_id = fixture.core->active.command_id;
    domain_reply_apply(fixture.core, &reply);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, fixture.core->active.state);
    memset(&loaded, 0, sizeof(loaded));
    TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_operation_load(fixture.core, &id, 1, &loaded));
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, loaded.state);
    TEST_CHECK_STRING("COMMAND_REJECTED", loaded.reason_code);

    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
}

/* NO_CHANGE 也是终态：设备侧那次动作上下文必须释放，否则下一次 EXECUTE
   永远 BUSY，柜子只能用一次（审计 R3-B-2 探针：NO_CHANGE 之后
   release_pending=0、release_calls=0）。释放以快照里的 active_operation_id
   为准闭合，而不是凭物理版本变了就宣布设备已放手（uart-v1.md:402）。 */
static void test_release_after_no_change(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;
    locker_device_event_t event;
    locker_device_reply_t reply;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 1u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT);
    dv_arm_operation(fixture.core, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                     LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_ACTIVE, 0x50u);
    dt_uuid_fill(&fixture.core->active.command_id, 0x90u);
    fixture.core->active.has_command = true;
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_pending);

    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_DOOR_OPENED, 1u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_OPEN;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_DOOR_CLOSED, 2u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED;
    event.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_NO_CHANGE, fixture.core->active.state);

    /* NO_CHANGE 之后必须登记释放。 */
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->release_pending);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_sent);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(0x50u, fixture.core->release_operation_id.bytes[0]);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(0x90u, fixture.core->release_command_id.bytes[0]);

    /* 泵把释放发出去，guard 带的是被释放那条动作的身份。 */
    domain_release_pump(fixture.core);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(1u, fixture.device->release_calls);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->release_sent);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(0x50u, fixture.device->last_release.operation_id.bytes[0]);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(0x90u, fixture.device->last_release.command_id.bytes[0]);

    /* CAS 失败（CONFLICT）：不能凭「物理版本变了」宣布已放手，只能转查询。 */
    fixture.device->release_status = LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    fixture.core->release_sent = false;
    domain_release_pump(fixture.core);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->release_recheck);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->release_pending);
    /* 只查询期间不再重发。 */
    {
        uint32_t before = fixture.device->release_calls;
        domain_release_pump(fixture.core);
        TEST_CHECK_U64(before, fixture.device->release_calls);
    }
    fixture.device->release_status = LOCKER_STATUS_OK;

    /* 快照仍挂着我们要释放的那条：解除只查询、允许用新版本重发一次。 */
    fixture.core->snapshot_in_flight = true;
    memset(&reply, 0, sizeof(reply));
    reply.message_type = (uint8_t)(2u | 0x80u);
    reply.body.get_snapshot.result = LOCKER_WIRE_RESULT_OK;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.session_id = fixture.core->session.session_id;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.journal_epoch = fixture.core->session.journal_epoch;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.boot_id = 1u;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.physical_revision = 20u;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.active_operation_id = fixture.core->release_operation_id;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.active_command_id = fixture.core->release_command_id;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.device_mode = LOCKER_WIRE_WIRE_DEVICE_MODE_READY;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.journal_state = LOCKER_WIRE_WIRE_JOURNAL_STATE_HEALTHY;
    domain_reply_apply(fixture.core, &reply);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_recheck);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_sent);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->release_pending);
    domain_release_pump(fixture.core);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(3u, fixture.device->release_calls);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(20u, fixture.device->last_release.expected_physical_revision);

    /* 新快照里设备已不再持有任何动作：释放目的达成，标志清空。 */
    fixture.core->snapshot_in_flight = true;
    memset(&reply, 0, sizeof(reply));
    reply.message_type = (uint8_t)(2u | 0x80u);
    reply.body.get_snapshot.result = LOCKER_WIRE_RESULT_OK;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.session_id = fixture.core->session.session_id;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.journal_epoch = fixture.core->session.journal_epoch;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.boot_id = 1u;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.physical_revision = 21u;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.device_mode = LOCKER_WIRE_WIRE_DEVICE_MODE_READY;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.journal_state = LOCKER_WIRE_WIRE_JOURNAL_STATE_HEALTHY;
    domain_reply_apply(fixture.core, &reply);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_pending);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_sent);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_recheck);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->device_active_valid);
    TEST_CHECK(locker_uuid_is_nil(&fixture.core->device_active_operation_id));

    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
}

/* 确认依据必须绑定完整代际，而不只是 physical_revision。
   physical_revision 只在同一次 boot 内单调（internal-interfaces.md:12），
   换 boot 之后 revision 从头计数，只比大小会把「设备重启后的旧事实」当成
   「更早的陈旧事实」放过（审计 R3-B-3 探针 A：冻结 boot=1/rev=9，
   送来 boot=2/rev=1 的成功快照仍保持 WAIT_CONFIRM）。 */
static void test_confirm_basis_generation(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;
    locker_device_event_t event;
    locker_device_reply_t reply;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 1u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT);
    dv_arm_operation(fixture.core, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                     LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_ACTIVE, 0x50u);

    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_DOOR_OPENED, 1u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_OPEN;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_DOOR_CLOSED, 2u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED;
    event.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_WAIT_CONFIRM, fixture.core->active.state);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->active.wait_confirm_basis_valid);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(1u, fixture.core->active.wait_confirm_boot_id);
    TEST_CHECK(locker_uuid_equal(&fixture.core->active.wait_confirm_journal_epoch,
                                 &fixture.core->physical.journal_epoch));

    /* 设备重启过（boot 2）、revision 比冻结值小：换 boot 说明事实序列已经重来，
       这不是「更早的陈旧事实」，必须作废确认依据。 */
    fixture.core->snapshot_in_flight = true;
    memset(&reply, 0, sizeof(reply));
    reply.message_type = (uint8_t)(2u | 0x80u);
    reply.body.get_snapshot.result = LOCKER_WIRE_RESULT_OK;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.session_id = fixture.core->session.session_id;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.journal_epoch = fixture.core->session.journal_epoch;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.boot_id = 2u;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.physical_revision = 1u;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.device_mode = LOCKER_WIRE_WIRE_DEVICE_MODE_READY;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.journal_state = LOCKER_WIRE_WIRE_JOURNAL_STATE_HEALTHY;
    domain_reply_apply(fixture.core, &reply);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, fixture.core->active.state);
    TEST_CHECK_STRING("PHYSICAL_CHANGED", fixture.core->active.reason_code);

    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
}

/* 终结落库后崩溃：内存里的 release_pending 全丢，而 MCU 侧的 has_active 还在。
   重启后必须从快照的 active_operation_id 重新登记释放，否则 release_calls
   永远是 0，柜子只能用一次（审计 R3-B-2 尚存项）。 */
static void test_release_after_restart(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;
    locker_device_reply_t reply;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 1u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT);
    /* 恢复后内存里没有活动操作，但设备侧还挂着上一次动作。 */
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->active.used);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_pending);

    fixture.core->snapshot_in_flight = true;
    memset(&reply, 0, sizeof(reply));
    reply.message_type = (uint8_t)(2u | 0x80u);
    reply.body.get_snapshot.result = LOCKER_WIRE_RESULT_OK;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.session_id = fixture.core->session.session_id;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.journal_epoch = fixture.core->session.journal_epoch;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.boot_id = 1u;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.physical_revision = 7u;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.device_mode = LOCKER_WIRE_WIRE_DEVICE_MODE_READY;
    reply.body.get_snapshot.journal_state = LOCKER_WIRE_WIRE_JOURNAL_STATE_HEALTHY;
    dt_uuid_fill(&reply.body.get_snapshot.active_operation_id, 0x77u);
    dt_uuid_fill(&reply.body.get_snapshot.active_command_id, 0x78u);
    domain_reply_apply(fixture.core, &reply);

    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->release_pending);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->release_sent);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(0x77u, fixture.core->release_operation_id.bytes[0]);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(0x78u, fixture.core->release_command_id.bytes[0]);
    domain_release_pump(fixture.core);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(1u, fixture.device->release_calls);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(0x77u, fixture.device->last_release.operation_id.bytes[0]);
    /* 释放未完成期间不许武装新动作：那条路径由
       test_domain_commands.c::test_presence_blocked_while_releasing 覆盖。 */

    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
}

/* HISTORY_INCOMPLETE 是锁存：设备报「我丢过关键事件」之后，序号连续也不能
   当成完整证据推进到确认（uart-v1.md:50、审计 R4-B-2 探针 A/B）。 */
static void test_event_history_incomplete(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;
    locker_device_event_t event;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 1u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT);
    dv_arm_operation(fixture.core, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                     LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_ACTIVE, 0x50u);

    /* 序号连续（1、2），但第二条自己带 HISTORY_INCOMPLETE。 */
    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_DOOR_OPENED, 1u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_OPEN;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->cursor.continuity_ok);

    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_ITEM_REMOVED, 2u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_OPEN;
    event.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;
    event.flags = DOMAIN_OBSERVATION_FLAG_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->cursor.continuity_ok);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->fetch_gap);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->active.history_complete);

    /* 之后门关、物品也符合 BORROW 的期望终态：仍然不能推进到 WAIT_CONFIRM。 */
    event = dv_event(fixture.core, LOCKER_DEVICE_EVENT_DOOR_CLOSED, 3u, true);
    event.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED;
    event.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;
    dv_attach_active(fixture.core, &event);
    domain_event_apply(fixture.core, &event);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, fixture.core->active.state);
    TEST_CHECK_STRING("HISTORY_INCOMPLETE", fixture.core->active.reason_code);

    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
}

/*
 * S1-04 业务核心：命令侧（申请 / 取消 / 确认 / 核验 / 柜前证明 / outbox / 超时）。
 *
 * 这里钉死的规则（对应任务卡与 internal-interfaces.md）：
 *   1. 两申请竞争只有一条活路：后到的明确 BUSY，不排队、不覆盖前者。
 *   2. 只有本人能确认/取消自己的操作；错误用户一律 INVALID。
 *   3. 提前确认（还在 REQUESTED/ACCESS_ACTIVE）一律 CONFLICT，不能跳步。
 *   4. 确认要同时满足物理终态与 item_transition_seen，缺一个就进 REVIEW_REQUIRED。
 *   5. 可能已执行的动作，取消只是核验请求（REVIEW_REQUIRED + 响应 CONFLICT）。
 *   6. 核验（resolve）只有 ADMIN、必须匹配 kind、门必须闭、物品必须明确。
 *   7. 到柜证明 15 秒过期：过期后重新进 REVIEW_REQUIRED，不能拿旧证明开门。
 *   8. outbox 先落「已尝试发送」检查点再发；检查点失败绝不发送。
 *   9. 发送后结果未知只查不重发；端口 BUSY 不算失败。
 *  10. 所有超时都有确定出口，且不会把 REVIEW_REQUIRED 再推回去。
 */

#include "domain_test_support.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

/* ---------- 命令/查询执行辅助 ---------- */

static locker_command_t dc_command(const locker_principal_t *principal, const char *kind, const char *arguments,
                                   uint8_t request_seed, uint8_t idem_seed)
{
    locker_command_t command;
    memset(&command, 0, sizeof(command));
    command.principal = *principal;
    dt_uuid_fill(&command.request_id, request_seed);
    if (idem_seed != 0u) {
        dt_uuid_fill(&command.idempotency_key, idem_seed);
    }
    (void)snprintf(command.kind, sizeof(command.kind), "%s", kind);
    (void)snprintf(command.arguments_json, sizeof(command.arguments_json), "%s", arguments);
    return command;
}

/* 跑一条命令并取回终态；返回领域状态（不是 IO 状态）。 */
static locker_status_t dc_run_command(dt_fixture_t *fixture, const locker_command_t *command,
                                      locker_query_result_t *result)
{
    domain_job_t job;
    locker_uuid_t token;
    uint32_t slot;

    memset(&job, 0, sizeof(job));
    memset(result, 0, sizeof(*result));
    slot = domain_completion_acquire(fixture->core, &token);
    TEST_CHECK(slot != UINT32_MAX);
    if (slot == UINT32_MAX) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_IO_ERROR;
    }
    job.kind = (uint8_t)DOMAIN_JOB_COMMAND;
    job.completion = slot;
    /* 令牌必须随作业下发：响应写回前会核对槽的归属（审计 R3-B-14）。
       这里走 domain_handle_job 而不是直接调 domain_handle_command，
       正是为了让「设置作业令牌」这条真实分发路径也进测试覆盖。 */
    job.completion_token = token;
    job.body.command = *command;
    domain_handle_job(fixture->core, &job);
    if (domain_completion_wait_final(fixture->core, slot, &token, 0u, result) != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        domain_completion_release(fixture->core, slot);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    domain_completion_release(fixture->core, slot);
    return result->status;
}

static locker_status_t dc_run_query(dt_fixture_t *fixture, const locker_query_t *query,
                                    locker_query_result_t *result)
{
    domain_job_t job;
    locker_uuid_t token;
    uint32_t slot;

    memset(&job, 0, sizeof(job));
    memset(result, 0, sizeof(*result));
    slot = domain_completion_acquire(fixture->core, &token);
    TEST_CHECK(slot != UINT32_MAX);
    if (slot == UINT32_MAX) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_IO_ERROR;
    }
    job.kind = (uint8_t)DOMAIN_JOB_QUERY;
    job.completion = slot;
    job.completion_token = token;
    job.body.query = *query;
    domain_handle_job(fixture->core, &job);
    if (domain_completion_wait_final(fixture->core, slot, &token, 0u, result) != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        domain_completion_release(fixture->core, slot);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    domain_completion_release(fixture->core, slot);
    return result->status;
}

/*
 * 响应必须是契约里的信封：{data, snapshot_revision, request_id}——
 * 顶层恰好三个成员，data 是一个完整的 JSON 值。
 *
 * 这条断言是补漏来的：以前这里只对 json 做子串匹配
 * （test_text_contains），所以「多一层大括号」这种断头 JSON
 * （{"data":{{"id":…）在单测里永远是绿的，直到集成测试解析响应
 * 才炸出来。凡是拿到 result->json 的地方都应该先过这里。
 */
static bool dc_envelope_ok(dt_fixture_t *fixture, const locker_query_result_t *result)
{
    locker_json_document_t doc;
    const locker_json_node_t *root;

    memset(&doc, 0, sizeof(doc));
    doc.text = result->json;
    doc.length = result->length;
    doc.nodes = fixture->core->arg_nodes;
    doc.node_capacity = LOCKER_DOMAIN_DOC_NODES;
    doc.members = fixture->core->arg_members;
    doc.member_capacity = LOCKER_DOMAIN_DOC_MEMBERS;
    TEST_CHECK(result->length > 0u);
    if (!locker_domain_json_parse(&doc, result->json, result->length)) {
        TEST_CHECK(false);
        return false;
    }
    root = locker_domain_json_root(&doc);
    TEST_CHECK(root != NULL && root->type == LOCKER_JSON_OBJECT);
    if (root == NULL || root->type != LOCKER_JSON_OBJECT) {
        return false;
    }
    /* 顶层恰好三个成员，且就是契约规定的三个：多一个少一个都不算信封。
       locker_json_node_t 不带成员名，所以用「个数 + 三个必选键都在」等价判定。 */

/* ---------- 开放前恢复 ---------- */

static void test_recover_empty(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, false));
    if (fixture.core == NULL) {
        dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
        return;
    }
    TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, domain_recover(NULL));

    TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_recover(fixture.core));
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->recovery_done);
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->recovery_ready);
    /* 恢复本身只把相位推到 RECOVERING；READY 由所有者线程在恢复成功后设置。 */
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->phase == DOMAIN_PHASE_RECOVERING);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->active.used);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->loan_open);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->persisted_state_valid);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(1u, fixture.core->next_action_no);
    /* 三个集合走恢复端口（operations/loans/import_cursors）；device_state 与
       tools 走普通查询端口：一次取版本、一次取快照记录、一次取工具投影
       ——create 要靠它校验 tool_id/tool_revision，不恢复等于所有申请都因为
       「工具不可知」被拒（审计 R1-B-9）。 */
    TEST_CHECK_U64(3u, (uint64_t)fixture.repo->recovery_calls);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(3u, (uint64_t)fixture.repo->query_calls);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(0u, fixture.core->revision);

    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
}

static void test_recover_operations(void)
{
    locker_uuid_t id;
    locker_uuid_t tool;
    locker_uuid_t actor;

    /* REQUESTED：截止时间按记录里的 updated_at 还原，不是 now + TTL。 */
    {
        dt_fixture_t fixture;
        TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, false));
        if (fixture.core == NULL) {
            dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
            return;
        }
        dt_uuid_fill(&id, 0x21u);
        dt_uuid_fill(&tool, 0x22u);
        dt_uuid_fill(&actor, 0x23u);
        TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_operation(&fixture, &id, &tool, &actor, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                                     LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REQUESTED, 2u, "2025-10-21T00:00:00Z"));
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_recover(fixture.core));
        TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->active.used);
        TEST_CHECK(locker_uuid_equal(&fixture.core->active.id, &id));
        TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REQUESTED, fixture.core->active.state);
        /* 截止点必须落在**单调时间域**：记录里的 updated_at 是墙钟（1.7e12 量级），
           不能直接加 TTL 当成 monotonic 毫秒——那样得到的 deadline 永远追不上
           now，重启前挂着的申请就再也不会超时（审计 R1-B-5）。
           这里 updated_at 正好等于当前墙钟，所以剩余时长就是完整 TTL，
           单调域上的 deadline = now_mono + TTL。 */
        TEST_CHECK_U64(fixture.core->now_ms + LOCKER_REQUEST_TTL_MS,
                       fixture.core->active.requested_deadline_ms);
        dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
    }

    /* WAIT_CONFIRM：重启后一律进核验，不保留可确认状态。
       冻结的物理依据只活在内存里，重启后无法证明「门还关着、物品仍是那一次
       变动后的样子」，允许本人确认等于凭无法追溯的记忆改账
       （stage-00-architecture.md:119；审计 R3-B-4）。 */
    {
        dt_fixture_t fixture;
        TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, false));
        if (fixture.core == NULL) {
            dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
            return;
        }
        dt_uuid_fill(&id, 0x31u);
        dt_uuid_fill(&tool, 0x32u);
        dt_uuid_fill(&actor, 0x33u);
        TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_operation(&fixture, &id, &tool, &actor, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                                     LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_WAIT_CONFIRM, 4u, "2025-10-21T00:00:00Z"));
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_recover(fixture.core));
        TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->active.used);
        TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, fixture.core->active.state);
        TEST_CHECK_STRING("RECOVERED_AFTER_RESTART", fixture.core->active.reason_code);
        /* 确认截止点已经没有意义：状态不再是 WAIT_CONFIRM。 */
        TEST_CHECK_U64(0u, fixture.core->active.wait_confirm_deadline_ms);
        dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
    }

    /* 终态历史不重建工作副本。 */
    {
        dt_fixture_t fixture;
    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
        TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, false));
        if (fixture.core == NULL) {
            dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
            return;
        }
        dt_uuid_fill(&id, 0x41u);
        dt_uuid_fill(&tool, 0x42u);
        dt_uuid_fill(&actor, 0x43u);
        TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_operation(&fixture, &id, &tool, &actor, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                                     LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_COMPLETED, 6u, "2025-10-21T00:00:00Z"));
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_recover(fixture.core));
        TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->active.used);
        dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
    }
}

static void test_recover_access_pending_review(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;
    locker_uuid_t id;
    locker_uuid_t tool;
    locker_uuid_t actor;
    char key[LOCKER_DOMAIN_UUID_TEXT];
    dt_doc_t *doc;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, false));
    if (fixture.core == NULL) {
        dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
        return;
    }
    dt_uuid_fill(&id, 0x51u);
    dt_uuid_fill(&tool, 0x52u);
    dt_uuid_fill(&actor, 0x53u);
    TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_operation(&fixture, &id, &tool, &actor, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW,
                                 LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_PENDING, 3u, "2025-10-21T00:00:00Z"));

    TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_recover(fixture.core));
    /* 可能已发送的意图：进核验，绝不重放发送。 */
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->active.used);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, fixture.core->active.state);
    TEST_CHECK_STRING("RECOVERED_AFTER_RESTART", fixture.core->active.reason_code);
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->active.send_started);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(4u, fixture.core->active.revision);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(1u, (uint64_t)fixture.repo->commit_calls);
    TEST_CHECK_U64(1u, fixture.core->revision);

    dt_uuid_text(&id, key, sizeof(key));
    doc = dt_repo_find(fixture.repo, "operations", key);
    TEST_CHECK(doc != NULL);
    if (doc != NULL) {
        TEST_CHECK(test_text_contains(doc->value, "\"state\":\"REVIEW_REQUIRED\""));
        TEST_CHECK(test_text_contains(doc->value, "RECOVERED_AFTER_RESTART"));
    }

# S1-04 business core unit tests.
#
# Same rule as S1-01..S1-03: no third-party test framework, one executable per
# test file, one CTest case per executable, non-zero exit is the only failure
# signal. The core is driven in-process through its public ports plus the
# private domain entry points; the repository, the device adapter and the
# publisher are the fakes in domain_test_support.h, so no SQLite file, no
# socket and no thread scheduling race is involved.

set(LOCKER_DOMAIN_TESTS
    test_domain_text
    test_domain_json
    test_domain_repo
    test_domain_state
    test_domain_device
    test_domain_commands
    test_domain_core
)

# 开发期只编一个文件时用 -DLOCKER_DOMAIN_TESTS_FILTER=<name>；默认编全部。
if(DEFINED LOCKER_DOMAIN_TESTS_FILTER)
    set(LOCKER_DOMAIN_TESTS ${LOCKER_DOMAIN_TESTS_FILTER})
endif()

foreach(test_name IN LISTS LOCKER_DOMAIN_TESTS)
    add_executable(${test_name} ${test_name}.c)
    target_link_libraries(${test_name} PRIVATE locker_domain Threads::Threads)
    target_include_directories(${test_name} PRIVATE
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../common"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/host/domain/src")
    set_target_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
    locker_apply_warnings(${test_name})
    add_test(NAME domain.${test_name} COMMAND ${test_name})
    set_tests_properties(domain.${test_name} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 120)
endforeach()

        return status;

    core->active = operation;

    /* 落库后的响应 snapshot_revision 用提交后的真实版本。 */
    locker_json_writer_t final_writer;
    domain_response_begin(&final_writer, core->response_buffer, sizeof(core->response_buffer));
    /* 投影自带完整 `{...}`；用 end_value 收尾，避免多补一层 `}`。 */
    domain_write_operation_projection(&final_writer, core, &operation);
    domain_response_end_value(&final_writer, core->revision, &command->request_id);
    response_finish_json(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_OK, true, &operation.id, &final_writer);
    return LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
}

/* ---------- OPERATION_CONFIRM / CANCEL / RESOLVE ---------- */

static bool parse_revision_request(locker_core_t *core, const locker_command_t *command, uint64_t *out_revision,
                                   char *out_reason, size_t reason_size, bool require_reason, bool *has_reason)
{
    locker_json_document_t doc;
    memset(&doc, 0, sizeof(doc));
    doc.nodes = core->arg_nodes;
    doc.node_capacity = LOCKER_DOMAIN_DOC_NODES;
    doc.members = core->arg_members;
    doc.member_capacity = LOCKER_DOMAIN_DOC_MEMBERS;
    size_t length = domain_strnlen(command->arguments_json, sizeof(command->arguments_json));
    if (length == 0u || !locker_domain_json_parse(&doc, command->arguments_json, length)) {
        return false;
    }
    const locker_json_node_t *root = locker_domain_json_root(&doc);
    if (root == NULL || root->type != LOCKER_JSON_OBJECT) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!domain_json_read_u64(&doc, domain_json_member(&doc, root, "operation_revision"), out_revision)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (out_reason != NULL && reason_size > 0u) {
        out_reason[0] = '\0';
        if (has_reason != NULL) {
            *has_reason = false;
        }
        const locker_json_node_t *reason = domain_json_member(&doc, root, "reason");
        if (reason != NULL && reason->type == LOCKER_JSON_STRING) {
            if (!domain_json_read_text(&doc, reason, out_reason, reason_size)) {
                return false;
            }
            if (has_reason != NULL) {
                *has_reason = true;
            }
        } else if (require_reason) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

static locker_status_t command_operation_confirm(locker_core_t *core, const locker_command_t *command, uint32_t slot,
                                                 const char *request_hash)
{
    uint64_t revision = 0u;
    if (!parse_revision_request(core, command, &revision, NULL, 0u, false, NULL)) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    domain_operation_t operation;
    locker_status_t status = domain_operation_load(core, &command->resource_id, 0, &operation);
    if (status != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        response_finish(core, slot, status, false, NULL);
        return status;
    }
    if (!locker_uuid_equal(&operation.actor_id, &command->principal.user_id)) {
        /* 错误用户：不能替别人确认。 */
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    if (operation.revision != revision) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    if (operation.state != LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_WAIT_CONFIRM) {
        /* 提前确认（还在 ACCESS_ACTIVE/REQUESTED）一律拒绝。 */
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    /* 确认前重验当前物理条件：门必须闭、物品必须已到期望终态、连续性完好。 */
    if (!physical_ready_for_action(core) || core->physical.item != resulting_item_for_kind(operation.kind) ||
        !operation.item_transition_seen) {
        status = domain_require_review(core, &operation, "CONFIRM_PRECONDITION");
        response_finish(core, slot, status == LOCKER_STATUS_OK ? LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT : status, false, NULL);
        return status;
    }
    /* 决策点再核一遍冻结依据：设备侧每次收到新事实都会判一次，但「判定」与
       「确认」之间还可能插入一份新快照。只信设备侧那一次，存储失败期间
       （转核验没落库、内存仍 WAIT_CONFIRM）就能把已知冲突直接确认完成
       （审计 R3-B-3 探针 B）。 */
    if (core->active.used && locker_uuid_equal(&core->active.id, &operation.id)) {
        if (core->active.wait_confirm_blocked || domain_wait_confirm_basis_conflicted(core, &core->active)) {
            status = domain_require_review(core, &core->active, "PHYSICAL_CHANGED");
            response_finish(core, slot, status == LOCKER_STATUS_OK ? LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT : status, false, NULL);
            return status;
        }
    }
    /* 不要先把仓储副本装进 core->active 再走事务：提交失败时活动工作副本
       已经被这份「重载出来的记录」覆盖，原来那个正在计时的申请连同它的运行时
       截止点一起丢了，占位再也不会自然到期（审计 R3-B-13：取消失败后
       active.deadline 被换成 UTC 量级的截止点，推进 130 s 仍是 REQUESTED、
       used=1）。所有终结都只在局部副本上准备，finish_operation 提交成功后
       才动内存。 */
    domain_operation_t target = operation;
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    if (operation.state == LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REQUESTED) {
        /* 还没有任何动作意图：可以安全取消并释放占位。
           同样只在局部副本上终结：core->active 是正在计时的那份工作副本，
           取消提交失败时它必须保持原样（见 R3-B-13 的说明）。 */
        domain_operation_t target = operation;
        /* 取消理由必须落库：CancelRequest.reason 是必填字段
           （contract-source.json 的 schemas.CancelRequest），以前只校验长度就
           丢掉，事后无从知道用户为什么撤单（审计 R3-B-6 后半）。审计与终结、
           幂等记录同一个事务，任何一条写不进去就整体不生效。 */
        domain_finish_extras_t extras;
        memset(&extras, 0, sizeof(extras));
        extras.command = command;
        extras.request_hash = request_hash;
        extras.audit_actor = &command->principal;
        extras.audit_type = "OPERATION_CANCELLED";
        extras.audit_reason = reason;
        locker_json_writer_t writer;
        status = finish_operation(core, &target, LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_CANCELLED, "CANCELLED", false, &extras,
                                  &writer);
        if (status != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
            response_finish(core, slot, status, false, NULL);
            return status;
        }
        domain_operation_reset(&target);
        response_finish_json(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_OK, true, &operation.id, &writer);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
    }
    if (domain_terminal_state(operation.state)) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    /* 可能已执行：取消只能是核验请求，不能声称取消成功（internal-interfaces.md:110）。 */
    status = domain_require_review(core, &operation, "CANCEL_AFTER_ACTION");
    response_finish(core, slot, status == LOCKER_STATUS_OK ? LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT : status, false, NULL);
    return status;
}

static locker_status_t command_operation_resolve(locker_core_t *core, const locker_command_t *command, uint32_t slot,
                                                 const char *request_hash)
{
    if (command->principal.role != LOCKER_ROLE_ADMIN) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    locker_json_document_t doc;
    memset(&doc, 0, sizeof(doc));
    doc.nodes = core->arg_nodes;
    doc.node_capacity = LOCKER_DOMAIN_DOC_NODES;
    doc.members = core->arg_members;
    doc.member_capacity = LOCKER_DOMAIN_DOC_MEMBERS;
    size_t length = domain_strnlen(command->arguments_json, sizeof(command->arguments_json));
    if (length == 0u || !locker_domain_json_parse(&doc, command->arguments_json, length)) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    const locker_json_node_t *root = locker_domain_json_root(&doc);
    uint64_t revision = 0u;
    uint64_t physical_revision = 0u;
    uint8_t resolution = 0u;
    char reason[257];
    if (root == NULL || !domain_json_read_u64(&doc, domain_json_member(&doc, root, "operation_revision"), &revision) ||
        !domain_json_read_u64(&doc, domain_json_member(&doc, root, "physical_revision"), &physical_revision) ||
        !domain_json_read_text(&doc, domain_json_member(&doc, root, "resolution"), reason, sizeof(reason))) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    {
        size_t resolution_length = strlen(reason);
        if (!domain_resolution_from_name(reason, resolution_length, &resolution)) {
            response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, false, NULL);
            return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
        }
    }
    char note[4097];
    if (!domain_json_read_text(&doc, domain_json_member(&doc, root, "reason"), note, sizeof(note)) ||
        strlen(note) < 5u) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    domain_operation_t operation;
    locker_status_t status = domain_operation_load(core, &command->resource_id, 0, &operation);
    if (status != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        response_finish(core, slot, status, false, NULL);
        return status;
    }
    if (operation.state != LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    if (operation.revision != revision) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    /* 核验只能匹配原操作类型，不能把借出核验成归还。 */
    if ((resolution == LOCKER_RESOLUTION_COMPLETE_BORROW && operation.kind != LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW) ||
        (resolution == LOCKER_RESOLUTION_COMPLETE_RETURN && operation.kind != LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_RETURN)) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    /* 门必须关闭、物品必须明确：传感器 UNKNOWN 时不允许强制完成。 */
    if (!core->device_snapshot_valid || core->physical.door != LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED ||
        core->physical.item == LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_UNKNOWN ||
        core->physical.physical_revision != physical_revision) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    /* 物理事实必须是新鲜的、而且来自当前会话。以前的检查只看内存里那份缓存
       值：设备断开几小时后，device_snapshot_valid 还是 true、door 还是
       CLOSED、item 还是 ABSENT，管理员拿着旧 physical_revision 就能把账本
       改成「已借出」——而这恰恰是最需要证据的时刻（审计 R1-B-12）。
       SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_MS 之外、或会话已断，都视为不可核验。 */
    if (!physical_evidence_fresh(core, domain_now(core))) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    /* 管理员核验也不能凭空改账本：结论必须与柜内物品现状相符。
       选 COMPLETE_BORROW 就是宣称「东西已被借出」，那物品必须已经离位；
       选 COMPLETE_RETURN 宣称「东西已还回」，那物品必须在位。
       只检查 operation.kind 而不检查物品，等于允许管理员在物品仍在柜里时
       把一个 BORROW 核验成 COMPLETED，直接凭空造出一条有效借用——这条路径
       绕过的是整条物理证据链，比普通 confirm 更危险。
       依据：docs/architecture/reviews/interface-expert.md:55（COMPLETED =
       物理证据和本人确认同事务核对通过，或管理员**有依据**核验）与
       stage-01-task-cards.md 的「不允许管理员无理由覆盖」。 */
    if (resolution == LOCKER_RESOLUTION_COMPLETE_BORROW &&
        core->physical.item != LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    if (resolution == LOCKER_RESOLUTION_COMPLETE_RETURN &&
        core->physical.item != LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT) {
        response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    /* NO_CHANGE 也不能随便选：规格要求「回到原基线」（stage-00-architecture.md:128），
       借出就是物品仍在位、归还就是物品仍离位。只看「不是 COMPLETE_*」就放行，
       等于允许管理员在物品已经离位时把一个 BORROW 核验成 NO_CHANGE，
       账面写着「什么都没发生」而柜子已经空了（审计 R3-B-11 探针②）。
       原基线不可知时同样拒绝：没有基线就没有「回到基线」可谈。 */
    if (resolution == LOCKER_RESOLUTION_NO_CHANGE) {
        const uint8_t baseline_item = operation.has_baseline ? operation.baseline.item : LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_UNKNOWN;
        if (baseline_item == LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_UNKNOWN || core->physical.item != baseline_item) {
            response_finish(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, false, NULL);
            return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
        }
    }
    /* 核验同样只在局部副本上准备：core->active 是正在计时的那份工作副本，
       直接在它上面终结会把「重载出来的记录」覆盖进去，提交失败时原来那个
       申请的运行时截止点就丢了（R3-B-13 的同类缺陷）。 */
    domain_operation_t target = operation;
    target.manual_resolution = true;
    uint8_t terminal = resolution == LOCKER_RESOLUTION_NO_CHANGE ? LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_NO_CHANGE
                                                                : LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_COMPLETED;
    bool apply_loan = resolution != LOCKER_RESOLUTION_NO_CHANGE;
    if (apply_loan) {
        status = domain_loan_prepare(core, &target);
        if (status != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
            response_finish(core, slot, status, true, &target.id);
            return status;
        }
    }
    /* 人工覆盖必须留下「谁、按什么理由、在什么时刻、基于哪一版物理事实」。
       以前 reason 只被校验长度就丢掉，reason_code 固定 ADMIN_RESOLVED，actor
       仍是原申请人，audits 集合里一条记录都没有——事后完全无法回答是谁批的
       （审计 R1-B-10，contract-source.json:1502 要求留原因）。审计记录现在与
       核验结论、账本变更、幂等记录同一个事务：任一条写不进去就整体不生效，
       不会出现「账已经改了但没有审计」这种事后无法追责的状态（R3-B-6）。 */
    domain_finish_extras_t extras;
    memset(&extras, 0, sizeof(extras));
    extras.command = command;
    extras.request_hash = request_hash;
    extras.audit_actor = &command->principal;
    extras.audit_type = "MANUAL_RESOLUTION";
    extras.audit_reason = note;
    extras.audit_physical_revision = physical_revision;
    locker_json_writer_t writer;
    status = finish_operation(core, &target, terminal, "ADMIN_RESOLVED", apply_loan, &extras, &writer);
    if (status != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        response_finish(core, slot, status, false, NULL);
        return status;
    }
    domain_operation_reset(&target);
    response_finish_json(core, slot, LOCKER_STATUS_OK, true, &operation.id, &writer);
    return LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
}

/* ---------- 审计记录 ---------- */

/* schema 的 maxLength 按 Unicode 字符数计（host/storage/src/schema.c:325 用
   utf8_count 统计码点），不是字节数。审计理由必须按码点截断，否则把 240 字节的
   80 个汉字截到 233 字节就会切在一个三字节字符中间，真仓储 utf8_count 返回
   false、整个核验事务失败——合法输入被实现破坏（审计 R3-B-6）。 */
static size_t audit_char_count(const char *text, size_t length)
{
    size_t count = 0u;
    for (size_t index = 0u; index < length; ++index) {
        if (((unsigned char)text[index] & 0xC0u) != 0x80u) {
            count += 1u;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

/* 前 max_chars 个码点占用的字节数；不足 max_chars 个码点时返回整个长度。 */
static size_t audit_prefix_bytes(const char *text, size_t length, size_t max_chars)
{
    size_t count = 0u;
    for (size_t index = 0u; index < length; ++index) {
        if (((unsigned char)text[index] & 0xC0u) == 0x80u) {
            continue; /* 续字节不计数，也不构成可截断边界 */
        }
        if (count == max_chars) {
            return index;
        }
        count += 1u;
    }
    return length;
}

static locker_status_t manual_audit_append(locker_core_t *core, domain_change_t *change,
                                           const domain_operation_t *operation, const locker_principal_t *actor,
                                           const char *type, const char *reason, uint64_t physical_revision)
{
    if (core->repo == NULL || change == NULL || operation == NULL || actor == NULL || reason == NULL) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    locker_uuid_t audit_id;
    if (locker_clock_port_new_uuid(&core->clock, &audit_id) != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_IO_ERROR;
    }
    char key[LOCKER_DOMAIN_UUID_TEXT];
    if (!domain_uuid_to_text(&audit_id, key, sizeof(key))) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    char occurred[LOCKER_DOMAIN_TIMESTAMP_TEXT];
    uint64_t wall = 0u;
    bool has_occurred = locker_clock_port_wall_utc_ms(&core->clock, &wall) == LOCKER_STATUS_OK &&
                        locker_domain_time_format_utc(wall, occurred, sizeof(occurred));
    /* AuditRecord.reason 上限 256（internal-data.schema.json$defs.AuditRecord），
       把物理版本并进 reason 的尾巴：审计表没有单独的 physical_revision 列，
       而「基于哪一版事实」是判断是否越权最关键的一条。超长就截断原文，
       宁可能读的字少一点，也不能让整条记录落库失败。 */
    const char suffix_prefix[] = " (physical_revision=";
    const char suffix_close[] = ")";
    char suffix[48];
    suffix[0] = '\0';
    size_t suffix_length = 0u;
    if (physical_revision != 0u) {
        int suffix_written = snprintf(suffix, sizeof(suffix), "%s%llu%s", suffix_prefix,
                                      (unsigned long long)physical_revision, suffix_close);
        if (suffix_written < 0 || (size_t)suffix_written >= sizeof(suffix)) {
            return LOCKER_STATUS_NO_SPACE;
        }
        suffix_length = (size_t)suffix_written;
    }
    char text[257];
    /* 256 是**字符**上限（internal-data.schema.json $defs.AuditRecord.reason
       maxLength:256，按码点计）。后缀是纯 ASCII，占的字符数等于字节数。 */
    size_t suffix_chars = suffix_length;
    size_t budget_chars = 256u - suffix_chars;
    size_t reason_length = strlen(reason);
    if (audit_char_count(reason, reason_length) > budget_chars) {
        reason_length = audit_prefix_bytes(reason, reason_length, budget_chars);
    }
    memcpy(text, reason, reason_length);
    memcpy(text + reason_length, suffix, suffix_length + 1u);
    if (!domain_change_put_begin(change, "audits", key)) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NO_SPACE;
    }
    domain_write_audit(&change->writer, &audit_id, &actor->user_id, &operation->id, type, text,
                       has_occurred ? occurred : NULL, has_occurred, NULL,
                       (uint8_t)LOCKER_TIME_QUALITY_HOST_SYNCED);
    domain_change_put_end(change);
    return LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
}

/* ---------- 柜前证明 ---------- */

static locker_status_t presence_apply(locker_core_t *core, const locker_presence_t *presence, uint8_t proof_source)
{
    if (core->phase != DOMAIN_PHASE_READY) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    /* 上一次动作的上下文还没在设备侧释放干净时，不许武装新的动作。
       释放未完成意味着 MCU 仍持有 has_active，新 EXECUTE 只会撞 BUSY 并被
       判成「命令被拒 → 核验」，把一次本来完全合法的到柜证明白白烧掉。
       这不是「等一会儿再试」的礼貌，而是同会话连续借还的前置条件
       （审计 R3-B-2：终结落库后、释放完成前提交的 presence 照样武装成功）。 */
    if (core->release_pending) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_BUSY;
    }
    domain_operation_t operation;
    locker_status_t status = domain_operation_load(core, &presence->operation_id, 0, &operation);
    if (status != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        return status;
    }
    if (!locker_uuid_equal(&operation.actor_id, &presence->principal.user_id)) {
        /* 证明只能属于操作本人。 */
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    if (operation.revision != presence->operation_revision) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    if (operation.state != LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REQUESTED) {
        /* 已提交动作意图后不再接受新的到柜证明。 */
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    if (operation.proof_consumed) {
        /* 一份柜前证明只算一次；过期作废由 operation_arm 的期限分支负责。 */
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    operation.proof_source = proof_source;
    operation.proof_ms = domain_now(core);
    operation.proof_consumed = true;
    core->active = operation;
    return LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
}

/*
 * REQUESTED -> ACCESS_PENDING：柜前证明 + 物理前置条件 + 视觉门禁都满足才提交
 * 唯一 command。事务里同时写 operation（含 command_id）、outbox 与占位保持。
 *
 * **arm 的全部字段填充与状态跃迁都在局部候选副本上完成，事务提交成功后才
 * 装回 core->active。** 直接改 core->active 再提交，提交一失败就会出现
 * 「内存里已经是 ACCESS_PENDING 且带 outbox、库里还是 REQUESTED」的分叉：
 * 处置超时或下一次 tick 看到内存状态就允许发送，于是**一个从未落库的动作被
 * 真的发到设备上**（internal-interfaces.md:98/:114 要求先提交后发送）。
 * 审计探针实测该路径：首次失败后 active_state=ACCESS_PENDING、sends=1，
 * 而 stored_state=REQUESTED。（R1-B-1）
 */
static locker_status_t operation_arm(locker_core_t *core)
{
    if (!core->active.used || core->active.state != LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REQUESTED) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    if (!core->active.proof_consumed) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    uint64_t now = domain_now(core);
    if (core->active.proof_ms == 0u || now < core->active.proof_ms ||
        now - core->active.proof_ms > LOCKER_PRESENCE_TTL_MS) {
        /* 15 秒证明过期：必须重新到柜，不能拿旧证明开门。 */
        core->active.proof_consumed = false;
        core->active.proof_source = 0u;
        (void)domain_require_review(core, &core->active, "PRESENCE_EXPIRED");
        return LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT;
    }
    if (core->vision_pre_required) {
        /* REQUIRED 策略需要 PRE_ACCESS 视觉证据；S1-04 只支持
           DISABLED_FOR_FOUNDATION，S2-14 才接入真实视觉门禁。 */
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    if (!physical_ready_for_action(core) ||
        core->physical.item != expected_item_for_kind(core->active.kind)) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    domain_operation_t candidate = core->active;

uint32_t domain_completion_acquire(locker_core_t *core, locker_uuid_t *out_token)
{
    if (core == NULL || out_token == NULL) {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    uint32_t slot = UINT32_MAX;
    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS; ++i) {
        if (!core->completions[i].used) {
            slot = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (slot != UINT32_MAX) {
        domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
        memset(completion, 0, sizeof(*completion));
        completion->used = true;
        if (locker_clock_port_new_uuid(&core->clock, &completion->token) != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
            memset(completion, 0, sizeof(*completion));
            slot = UINT32_MAX;
        } else {
            *out_token = completion->token;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
    return slot;
}

void domain_completion_release(locker_core_t *core, uint32_t slot)
{
    if (core == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS) {
        return;
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    free(completion->json);
    memset(completion, 0, sizeof(*completion));
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
}

void domain_completion_release_owned(locker_core_t *core, uint32_t slot, const locker_uuid_t *token)
{
    if (core == NULL || token == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS) {
        return;
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    /* 槽在等待期间可能已经被回收、又被下一个请求占用。此时按下标释放会
       抹掉别人的在途结果——只有令牌仍然对得上才清槽（审计 R3-B-14）。 */
    if (completion->used && locker_uuid_equal(&completion->token, token)) {
        free(completion->json);
        memset(completion, 0, sizeof(*completion));
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
}

bool domain_completion_token_matches(locker_core_t *core, uint32_t slot, const locker_uuid_t *token)
{
    if (core == NULL || token == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS) {
        return false;
    }
    bool matches = false;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    const domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    /* 作业在 Core 线程上异步执行：等待方可能已经超时释放，槽被别的请求复用。
       写结果前核对令牌，才能保证「谁的结果进谁的槽」（审计 R3-B-14）。 */
    matches = completion->used && locker_uuid_equal(&completion->token, token);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
    return matches;
}

void domain_completion_accept(locker_core_t *core, uint32_t slot, locker_status_t status,
                              const locker_uuid_t *operation_id, bool has_operation)
{
    if (core == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS) {
        return;
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    if (completion->used) {
        completion->accept_status = status;
        completion->has_operation = has_operation;
        if (has_operation && operation_id != NULL) {
            completion->operation_id = *operation_id;
        }
        completion->accept_ready = true;
        pthread_cond_broadcast(&core->completion_cond);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
}

void domain_completion_finish(locker_core_t *core, uint32_t slot, locker_status_t status,
                              const char *json, size_t length, uint64_t revision)
{
    if (core == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS) {
        return;
    }
    char *copy = NULL;
    if (json != NULL && length > 0u) {
        copy = (char *)malloc(length + 1u);
        if (copy == NULL) {
            status = LOCKER_STATUS_NO_SPACE;
        } else {
            memcpy(copy, json, length);
            copy[length] = '\0';
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    if (completion->used) {
        free(completion->json);
        completion->json = copy;
        completion->length = (copy != NULL) ? length : 0u;
        completion->final_status = status;
        completion->revision = revision;
        completion->final_ready = true;
        /* 终态保留到保留期结束：调用方可能因为排队延迟而晚到，不能提前清槽。 */
        completion->expires_ms = domain_now(core) + core->completion_retention_ms;
        pthread_cond_broadcast(&core->completion_cond);
    } else {
        free(copy);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
}

void domain_completion_fail(locker_core_t *core, uint32_t slot, locker_status_t status)
{
    /* 失败收尾不产生结果体：json 置空、length 置 0，调用方拿到的是纯状态。
       槽已释放（例如结果已被 take 走或已过保留期）时什么也不做，绝不复活旧槽。 */
    if (core == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS) {
        return;
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    if (completion->used) {
        free(completion->json);
        completion->json = NULL;
        completion->length = 0u;
        completion->final_status = status;
        completion->final_ready = true;
        completion->expires_ms = domain_now(core) + core->completion_retention_ms;
        pthread_cond_broadcast(&core->completion_cond);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
}

static void completion_deadline(uint32_t timeout_ms, struct timespec *out)
{
    /* 等待上限由契约固定：wait_result 最多 1000 ms，超时不取消。 */
    uint32_t capped = timeout_ms > LOCKER_CORE_RESULT_WAIT_MS ? LOCKER_CORE_RESULT_WAIT_MS : timeout_ms;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, out);
    out->tv_sec += (time_t)(capped / 1000u);
    out->tv_nsec += (long)(capped % 1000u) * 1000000L;
    if (out->tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
        out->tv_sec += 1;
        out->tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
    }
}

locker_status_t domain_completion_wait_accept(locker_core_t *core, uint32_t slot, uint32_t timeout_ms,
                                              locker_status_t *out_status, locker_uuid_t *out_operation,
                                              bool *out_has_operation)
{
    if (core == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS || out_status == NULL) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    struct timespec deadline;
    completion_deadline(timeout_ms, &deadline);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    while (completion->used && !completion->accept_ready) {
        int rc = pthread_cond_timedwait(&core->completion_cond, &core->completion_mutex, &deadline);
        if (rc != 0) {
            break;
        }
    }
    bool ready = completion->used && completion->accept_ready;
    locker_status_t status = LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
    if (ready) {
        *out_status = completion->accept_status;
        if (out_has_operation != NULL) {
            *out_has_operation = completion->has_operation;
        }
        if (out_operation != NULL) {
            *out_operation = completion->operation_id;
        }
    } else {
        status = LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
    return status;
}

locker_status_t domain_completion_wait_final(locker_core_t *core, uint32_t slot, const locker_uuid_t *token,
                                             uint32_t timeout_ms, locker_query_result_t *out_result)
{
    if (core == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS || token == NULL || out_result == NULL) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    struct timespec deadline;
    completion_deadline(timeout_ms, &deadline);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    /* 槽号不是身份：保留期结束后 reap 会把槽清空，下一个请求立刻复用它。
       只用槽号等待就会把**别人的终态**当成自己的结果交付（审计 R3-B-14）。
       这里在锁内逐轮核对 token：槽一换人立刻返回 NOT_READY，调用方按契约
       用幂等键重查，绝不会拿到不属于自己的响应体。 */
    while (completion->used && locker_uuid_equal(&completion->token, token) && !completion->final_ready) {
        int rc = pthread_cond_timedwait(&core->completion_cond, &core->completion_mutex, &deadline);
        if (rc != 0) {
            break;
        }
    }
    locker_status_t status = LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    if (completion->used && locker_uuid_equal(&completion->token, token) && completion->final_ready) {
        status = LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
        out_result->status = completion->final_status;
        out_result->snapshot_revision = completion->revision;
        out_result->length = 0u;
        out_result->json[0] = '\0';
        if (completion->json != NULL) {
            if (completion->length + 1u > sizeof(out_result->json)) {
                status = LOCKER_STATUS_NO_SPACE;
            } else {
                memcpy(out_result->json, completion->json, completion->length + 1u);
                out_result->length = completion->length;
            }
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
    return status;
}

uint32_t domain_completion_find(locker_core_t *core, const locker_uuid_t *token)
{
    if (core == NULL || token == NULL) {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    uint32_t found = UINT32_MAX;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS; ++i) {
        if (core->completions[i].used && locker_uuid_equal(&core->completions[i].token, token)) {
            found = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&core->completion_mutex);
    return found;
}

{
    if (core == NULL || slot >= LOCKER_DOMAIN_COMPLETION_SLOTS || principal == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&core->completion_mutex);
    domain_completion_t *completion = &core->completions[slot];
    if (completion->used) {
        completion->principal = *principal;

/*
 * S1-04 业务核心：命令侧（申请 / 取消 / 确认 / 核验 / 柜前证明 / outbox / 超时）。
 *
 * 这里钉死的规则（对应任务卡与 internal-interfaces.md）：
 *   1. 两申请竞争只有一条活路：后到的明确 BUSY，不排队、不覆盖前者。
 *   2. 只有本人能确认/取消自己的操作；错误用户一律 INVALID。
 *   3. 提前确认（还在 REQUESTED/ACCESS_ACTIVE）一律 CONFLICT，不能跳步。
 *   4. 确认要同时满足物理终态与 item_transition_seen，缺一个就进 REVIEW_REQUIRED。
 *   5. 可能已执行的动作，取消只是核验请求（REVIEW_REQUIRED + 响应 CONFLICT）。
 *   6. 核验（resolve）只有 ADMIN、必须匹配 kind、门必须闭、物品必须明确。
 *   7. 到柜证明 15 秒过期：过期后重新进 REVIEW_REQUIRED，不能拿旧证明开门。
 *   8. outbox 先落「已尝试发送」检查点再发；检查点失败绝不发送。
 *   9. 发送后结果未知只查不重发；端口 BUSY 不算失败。
 *  10. 所有超时都有确定出口，且不会把 REVIEW_REQUIRED 再推回去。
 */

#include "domain_test_support.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

/* ---------- 命令/查询执行辅助 ---------- */

static locker_command_t dc_command(const locker_principal_t *principal, const char *kind, const char *arguments,
                                   uint8_t request_seed, uint8_t idem_seed)
{
    locker_command_t command;
    memset(&command, 0, sizeof(command));
    command.principal = *principal;
    dt_uuid_fill(&command.request_id, request_seed);
    if (idem_seed != 0u) {
        dt_uuid_fill(&command.idempotency_key, idem_seed);
    }
    (void)snprintf(command.kind, sizeof(command.kind), "%s", kind);
    (void)snprintf(command.arguments_json, sizeof(command.arguments_json), "%s", arguments);
    return command;
}

/* 跑一条命令并取回终态；返回领域状态（不是 IO 状态）。 */
static locker_status_t dc_run_command(dt_fixture_t *fixture, const locker_command_t *command,
                                      locker_query_result_t *result)
{
    domain_job_t job;
    locker_uuid_t token;
    uint32_t slot;

    memset(&job, 0, sizeof(job));
    memset(result, 0, sizeof(*result));
    slot = domain_completion_acquire(fixture->core, &token);
    TEST_CHECK(slot != UINT32_MAX);
    if (slot == UINT32_MAX) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_IO_ERROR;
    }
    job.kind = (uint8_t)DOMAIN_JOB_COMMAND;
    job.completion = slot;
    /* 令牌必须随作业下发：响应写回前会核对槽的归属（审计 R3-B-14）。
       这里走 domain_handle_job 而不是直接调 domain_handle_command，
       正是为了让「设置作业令牌」这条真实分发路径也进测试覆盖。 */
    job.completion_token = token;
    job.body.command = *command;
    domain_handle_job(fixture->core, &job);
    if (domain_completion_wait_final(fixture->core, slot, &token, 0u, result) != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        domain_completion_release(fixture->core, slot);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    domain_completion_release(fixture->core, slot);
    return result->status;
}

static locker_status_t dc_run_query(dt_fixture_t *fixture, const locker_query_t *query,
                                    locker_query_result_t *result)
{
    domain_job_t job;
    locker_uuid_t token;
    uint32_t slot;

    memset(&job, 0, sizeof(job));
    memset(result, 0, sizeof(*result));
    slot = domain_completion_acquire(fixture->core, &token);
    TEST_CHECK(slot != UINT32_MAX);
    if (slot == UINT32_MAX) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_IO_ERROR;
    }
    job.kind = (uint8_t)DOMAIN_JOB_QUERY;
    job.completion = slot;
    job.completion_token = token;
    job.body.query = *query;
    domain_handle_job(fixture->core, &job);
    if (domain_completion_wait_final(fixture->core, slot, &token, 0u, result) != LOCKER_STATUS_OK) {
        domain_completion_release(fixture->core, slot);
        return LOCKER_STATUS_NOT_READY;
    }
    domain_completion_release(fixture->core, slot);
    return result->status;
}

    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 5u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT);
    TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_principal(&fixture, &principal));
    TEST_CHECK(dc_seed_active(&fixture, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW, LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_ACCESS_PENDING, 5u,
                              "2025-10-21T00:00:00Z", &id, &tool, &principal.user_id));
    {
        locker_command_t command = dc_command(&principal, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_CANCEL,
                                              "{\"operation_revision\":\"5\",\"reason\":\"too late\"}", 0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
        TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->active.state == LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED);
        TEST_CHECK_STRING("CANCEL_AFTER_ACTION", fixture.core->active.reason_code);
    }
    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
}

/* ---------- OPERATION_RESOLVE（管理员核验） ---------- */

static void test_resolve(void)
{
    dt_fixture_t fixture;
    locker_principal_t admin;
    locker_principal_t user;
    locker_query_result_t result;
    locker_uuid_t id;
    locker_uuid_t tool;

    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 5u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT);
    admin = dt_principal(LOCKER_ROLE_ADMIN, 0x80u);
    TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_principal(&fixture, &admin));
    user = dt_principal(LOCKER_ROLE_USER, 0x70u);
    TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_principal(&fixture, &user));
    dt_uuid_fill(&id, 0x51u);
    dt_uuid_fill(&tool, 0x22u);

    TEST_CHECK(dc_seed_active(&fixture, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW, LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, 6u,
                              "2025-10-21T00:00:00Z", &id, &tool, &user.user_id));

    /* 普通用户不能核验：不允许管理员无理由覆盖的反面也一样——越权一律 INVALID。 */
    {
        locker_command_t command = dc_command(&user, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_RESOLVE,
                                              "{\"operation_revision\":\"6\",\"physical_revision\":\"7\","
                                              "\"resolution\":\"COMPLETE_BORROW\",\"reason\":\"operator checked\"}",
                                              0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
    }
    /* 理由太短 -> INVALID（核验必须留下可审计的因果）。 */
    {
        locker_command_t command = dc_command(&admin, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_RESOLVE,
                                              "{\"operation_revision\":\"6\",\"physical_revision\":\"7\","
                                              "\"resolution\":\"COMPLETE_BORROW\",\"reason\":\"abc\"}",
                                              0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
    }
    /* resolution 与 kind 不匹配 -> INVALID。 */
    {
        locker_command_t command = dc_command(&admin, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_RESOLVE,
                                              "{\"operation_revision\":\"6\",\"physical_revision\":\"7\","
                                              "\"resolution\":\"COMPLETE_RETURN\",\"reason\":\"operator checked\"}",
                                              0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
    }
    /* 门开着 / 物品 UNKNOWN / 物理版本不符 都拒绝，不能强行结案。 */
    {
        locker_command_t command = dc_command(&admin, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_RESOLVE,
                                              "{\"operation_revision\":\"6\",\"physical_revision\":\"7\","
                                              "\"resolution\":\"COMPLETE_BORROW\",\"reason\":\"operator checked\"}",
                                              0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        fixture.core->physical.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_OPEN;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
        fixture.core->physical.door = LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED;

        fixture.core->physical.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_UNKNOWN;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
        fixture.core->physical.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;

        fixture.core->physical.physical_revision = 8u;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
        fixture.core->physical.physical_revision = 7u;

        /* 版本落后也拒绝。 */
        command = dc_command(&admin, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_RESOLVE,
                             "{\"operation_revision\":\"5\",\"physical_revision\":\"7\","
                             "\"resolution\":\"COMPLETE_BORROW\",\"reason\":\"operator checked\"}",
                             0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
    }
    /* 核验结论必须与柜内物品现状相符：东西还在柜里就不能核验成「已借出」。
       这条是补漏——早先只比对 operation.kind，管理员可以在物品仍在位时把
       BORROW 结案成 COMPLETED，凭空造出一条有效借用，绕开整条物理证据链。
       依据 interface-expert.md:55（COMPLETED = 物理证据与确认同事务核对通过，
       或管理员**有依据**核验）与 stage-01-task-cards.md「不允许管理员无理由覆盖」。 */
    {
        locker_command_t command = dc_command(&admin, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_RESOLVE,
                                              "{\"operation_revision\":\"6\",\"physical_revision\":\"7\","
                                              "\"resolution\":\"COMPLETE_BORROW\",\"reason\":\"operator checked\"}",
                                              0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        /* 本段 fixture 的物品是 ABSENT（已离位），符合 COMPLETE_BORROW；先改成在位。 */
        fixture.core->physical.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_CONFLICT, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
        /* 拒绝必须来自物品判定本身，而不是顺手把操作推走：状态与物理基线都不动。
           这里只验「拒绝」这一次调用——拒绝路径不消耗操作，改回离位后由下一段
           正常结案来证明通过性，不再塞第三次调用（那会拿 CONFLICT）。 */
        TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->active.used);
        TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->active.state == LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED);
        fixture.core->physical.item = LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;
    }
    /* 正常核验完成借出：终结 + 新建 loan。 */
    {
        locker_command_t command = dc_command(&admin, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_RESOLVE,
                                              "{\"operation_revision\":\"6\",\"physical_revision\":\"7\","
                                              "\"resolution\":\"COMPLETE_BORROW\",\"reason\":\"operator checked\"}",
                                              0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
    }
    TEST_CHECK(fixture.core->loan_open);
    TEST_CHECK(locker_uuid_equal(&fixture.core->loan_borrower_id, &user.user_id));
    {
        domain_operation_t loaded;
        memset(&loaded, 0, sizeof(loaded));
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, domain_operation_load(fixture.core, &id, 1, &loaded));
        TEST_CHECK(loaded.state == LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_COMPLETED);
        TEST_CHECK_STRING("ADMIN_RESOLVED", loaded.reason_code);
        TEST_CHECK(loaded.manual_resolution);
    }
    /* 人工核验必须留下可审计的因果：谁、为什么、依据哪个物理版本。
       以前 reason 只查长度不落库、actor 还是原申请人、reason_code 固定
       ADMIN_RESOLVED，事后无从追责（审计 R3-B-10/B-6）。 */
    {
        dt_doc_t *audit = NULL;
        uint32_t i;
        for (i = 0; i < DT_MAX_DOCS; i++) {
            if (fixture.repo->docs[i].used &&
                strcmp(fixture.repo->docs[i].collection, "audits") == 0) {
                audit = &fixture.repo->docs[i];
                break;
            }
        }
        TEST_CHECK(audit != NULL);
        if (audit != NULL) {
            TEST_CHECK(test_text_contains(audit->value, "\"type\":\"MANUAL_RESOLUTION\""));
            TEST_CHECK(test_text_contains(audit->value, "operator checked"));
            TEST_CHECK(test_text_contains(audit->value, "physical_revision=7"));
            /* actor 必须是执行核验的管理员，不是申请人。 */
            {
                char actor_text[64];
                char actor_member[96];
                TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK,
                                  locker_uuid_format(&admin.user_id, actor_text, sizeof(actor_text)));
                snprintf(actor_member, sizeof(actor_member), "\"actor_id\":\"%s\"", actor_text);
                TEST_CHECK(test_text_contains(audit->value, actor_member));
            }
        }
    }

    /* NO_CHANGE：核验为「什么都没发生」，不建 loan、不写账本。 */
    dt_fixture_free(&fixture);
    TEST_CHECK(dt_fixture_init(&fixture, true));
    dt_core_device_ready(&fixture, 5u, LOCKER_DOOR_STATE_CLOSED, LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT);
    TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_principal(&fixture, &admin));
    TEST_CHECK(dt_seed_principal(&fixture, &user));
    TEST_CHECK(dc_seed_active(&fixture, LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW, LOCKER_OPERATION_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, 3u,
                              "2025-10-21T00:00:00Z", &id, &tool, &user.user_id));
    {
        locker_command_t command = dc_command(&admin, LOCKER_CORE_OPERATION_RESOLVE,
                                              "{\"operation_revision\":\"3\",\"physical_revision\":\"7\","
                                              "\"resolution\":\"NO_CHANGE\",\"reason\":\"door never opened\"}",
                                              0x31u, 0u);
        command.resource_id = id;
        TEST_CHECK_STATUS(LOCKER_STATUS_OK, dc_run_command(&fixture, &command, &result));
    }
    TEST_CHECK(!fixture.core->loan_open);
    {
        domain_operation_t loaded;
        memset(&loaded, 0, sizeof(loaded));

 * S1-04 业务核心：命令、查询、状态机推进与超时。

 * 状态表真源是 docs/stages/stage-00-architecture.md:106-128；本文件是它唯一的

/* 幂等记录的有效期（契约 LOCKER_IDEMPOTENCY_DAYS 天）。 */
#define DOMAIN_IDEMPOTENCY_MS (LOCKER_IDEMPOTENCY_DAYS * 24u * 60u * 60u * 1000u)
/*
 * 物理事实的最长可核验龄期。设备的 HEALTH/SNAPSHOT 是秒级刷新，30 秒没刷新
 * 说明会话已经哑了（泵仍在重试但拿不到新事实）。核验改账本必须基于新鲜证据，
 * 不能让断开后的缓存值冒充「现在门是关的」。
 */
#define LOCKER_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_MS 30000u
/* 恢复/列表扫描的最大页数，防止一个损坏库把 Core 卡在循环里。 */

/* ---------- 通用小工具 ---------- */

static bool kind_matches_state(uint8_t kind, uint8_t state)
{
    (void)state;
    return kind == LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW || kind == LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_RETURN;
}

static uint8_t expected_item_for_kind(uint8_t kind)
{
    return kind == LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW ? LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT : LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT;
}

/* 期望的物品终态：借出后应缺席、归还后应在位。 */
static uint8_t resulting_item_for_kind(uint8_t kind)
{
    return kind == LOCKER_OPERATION_KIND_BORROW ? LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_ABSENT : LOCKER_ITEM_STATE_PRESENT;
}

/*
 * 终结事务里要一并落库的附加记录（R3-B-5 / R3-B-6）。
 *
 * 幂等记录与人工审计都必须和业务结果在**同一个** change 里提交。分成两次提交
 * 时，第一次成功、第二次失败会留下无法自愈的分叉：审计反例实测「只让含
 * idempotency mutation 的那次提交返回 IO_ERROR」，就得到 first=OK、
 * replay=CONFLICT、仓储里已经是 CANCELLED——客户端重试看到互相矛盾的结论；
 * 只让 audits 提交失败，则得到 status=OK、stored_state=COMPLETED、
 * loan_open=1、audits=0，事后完全查不到是谁批的。
 *
 * 一个 change 只有一块缓冲、只能提交一次，所以附加记录必须挂进调用方那个
 * change，不能各开一个。
 *
 * 谁：audit_actor 是**执行核验的那个管理员**，不是原申请人——两者经常不同，
 *     把申请人写进 actor_id 等于伪造授权链。
 * 为什么：audit_reason 是请求里带的原始文本（contract-source.json:1502 要求
 *     留下原因），不再只校验长度就丢掉。
 * 何时/基于什么：occurred_at 用墙钟，reason 里同时带上被核验的物理版本，
 *     这样事后能确认管理员看到的是哪一版柜内事实。
 */
typedef struct domain_finish_extras {
    const locker_command_t *command;       /* 幂等键非 nil 时写 IdempotencyRecord */
    const char *request_hash;              /* 与 command 配套 */
    const locker_principal_t *audit_actor; /* 非空时写 AuditRecord */
    const char *audit_type;                /* AuditRecord.type */
    const char *audit_reason;              /* AuditRecord.reason */
    uint64_t audit_physical_revision;      /* 非 0 时把物理版本并进 reason 尾巴 */
} domain_finish_extras_t;

static locker_status_t manual_audit_append(locker_core_t *core, domain_change_t *change,
                                           const domain_operation_t *operation, const locker_principal_t *actor,
                                           const char *type, const char *reason, uint64_t physical_revision);
static locker_status_t idempotency_append(locker_core_t *core, domain_change_t *change,
                                          const locker_command_t *command, const char *request_hash,
                                          const char *response_json);
static void build_operation_response(locker_core_t *core, locker_json_writer_t *writer,
                                     const domain_operation_t *operation, uint64_t revision,
                                     const locker_uuid_t *request_id);

/*
 * 物理事实「可核验」：必须在当前会话里、且采样足够新。
 *
 * physical_ready_for_action 是给**发起新动作**用的（还包括设备模式、日志
 * 健康、门状态）。核验用的门槛不一样：管理员要基于柜内现状改账本，只需要
 * 「这份物理事实是刚采到的」。两者都不能只看缓存值是否曾被填过一次。
 */
static bool physical_evidence_fresh(const locker_core_t *core, uint64_t now)

/* ---------- 可注入测试时钟 ---------- */

typedef struct test_clock {
    uint64_t monotonic_ms;
    uint64_t wall_ms;
    uint32_t uuid_counter;
} test_clock_t;

LOCKER_TEST_HELPER static uint64_t dt_clock_monotonic(void *user)
{
    test_clock_t *clock = (test_clock_t *)user;
    return (clock == NULL) ? 0u : clock->monotonic_ms;
}

LOCKER_TEST_HELPER static bool dt_clock_wall(void *user, uint64_t *out)
{
    test_clock_t *clock = (test_clock_t *)user;
    if (clock == NULL || out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    *out = clock->wall_ms;
    return true;
}

LOCKER_TEST_HELPER static locker_status_t dt_clock_uuid(void *user, locker_uuid_t *out)
{
    test_clock_t *clock = (test_clock_t *)user;
    if (clock == NULL || out == NULL) {
        return LOCKER_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    clock->uuid_counter += 1u;
    uint32_t value = clock->uuid_counter;
    memset(out->bytes, 0, sizeof(out->bytes));
    out->bytes[0] = (uint8_t)(value & 0xffu);
    out->bytes[1] = (uint8_t)((value >> 8u) & 0xffu);
    out->bytes[2] = (uint8_t)((value >> 16u) & 0xffu);
    out->bytes[3] = (uint8_t)((value >> 24u) & 0xffu);
    out->bytes[4] = 0x9au;
    out->bytes[5] = 0x5bu;
    out->bytes[6] = (uint8_t)(0x40u | (out->bytes[6] & 0x0fu));
    out->bytes[7] = 0x8cu;
    out->bytes[8] = 0x80u;
    out->bytes[9] = 0x1du;
    out->bytes[15] = (uint8_t)(value & 0xffu);
    return LOCKER_STATUS_OK;
}

LOCKER_TEST_HELPER static locker_clock_port_t dt_clock_port(test_clock_t *clock)
{
    locker_clock_port_t port;
    memset(&port, 0, sizeof(port));
    port.user = clock;
    port.monotonic_ms = dt_clock_monotonic;
    port.wall_utc_ms = dt_clock_wall;
    port.new_uuid = dt_clock_uuid;
    return port;
}

        uuid->bytes[i] = (uint8_t)(seed + i);
    }
